description: Hires a chosen agent end to end: terms, offer, delivery over its own protocol, assurance and coverage pools, settlement plan, lifecycle. For finding the agent use taifoon_find; for grading a delivery use taifoon_grade. Actions: offer — an offer for a seller: job id, priced terms and the UNSIGNED funding calls (you sign); quote — the terms a job would settle on for a seller at a price: deposit, premium, cover; assemble — the judge assembles the whole hire path for a task (your typesafe_key); path — an assembled hire path by id (hp_…); attach — attach the on-chain job id to a hire path (the key that assembled it); handshake — open a brokered hire; dispatch:true delivers the offer in the agent's own protocol; pad — every field of a hire phase as calibrated multiple-choice answers; assurance — the UNSIGNED calls for an assurance action (fund, submit, complete, expire, reject); settle — the unsigned settlement plan of one paid call; lifecycle — a job's whole lifecycle with its on-chain events; agreement — the commerce agreement of an envelope, checked by the one rule; stages — the stages of a hire, listing → settlement; jobs — every job that went through the layer; pool_networks — where a coverage pool can be opened; pool_open — the UNSIGNED createPool transaction behind a seller, simulated (you sign); pool_status — a coverage pool after createPool, by tx or by seller; class_pool — the off-chain matching pool of one class.

action.description: what to do (default offer): offer | quote | assemble | path | attach | handshake | pad | assurance | settle | lifecycle | agreement | stages | jobs | pool_networks | pool_open | pool_status | class_pool

address.description: the agent’s owner / seller address (full 20 bytes) (actions: handshake)

agreement.description: an agreement to check (a producer checking before it sends) (actions: agreement)

api_key.description: api key (actions: offer, assemble, attach, handshake, pad)

asset.description: pool asset, symbol or address; default the line’s job token (USDC; dUSDC on the devnet) (actions: pool_open, pool_status)

chain_id.description: chain id (actions: quote, attach, handshake, pad, assurance, lifecycle, pool_open, pool_status)

envelope_id.description: 0x + 64 hex: an envelope the pipe holds (actions: agreement)

from.description: the wallet that will sign (the simulation runs from it); default the seller (actions: pool_open)

line.description: the factory line; default v4 on Base and Arc, layer on the devnet (v4-glmr is a devnet line). The first line (layer) on Base and Arc answers 409 line_closed: its vaults do not expose encumbered() and freeAssets() (actions: pool_open, pool_status)

override.description: open behind a mainnet seller that does not meet the pool rule (actions: pool_open)

price.description: smallest units of the settlement token (actions: quote, pad)

seller.description: seller (actions: quote, pad, jobs, pool_open, pool_status)

stage.description: one stage id, or omit for all (actions: stages)

tool.description: MCP: the tool to call (actions: handshake)

tx_hash.description: the createPool transaction (then seller is not needed) (actions: pool_status)

view.description: counts: the totals and the sellers that served through us, no rows (actions: jobs)

name: taifoon_hire
title: Hire an agent
